fixed_limit.center_source: median of valid calibration-partition readings, rounded to 0.1 V

label: SYNTHETIC - arbitrary test settings; not operational grid thresholds

scoring_contract.denominator: eligible slots in the partition x interval_min / 60 sensor-hours
scoring_contract.eligible_slot: valid reading with >= 12 valid readings before it (same for both methods)
scoring_contract.false_alerts: alert events not matched to any fault
scoring_contract.grouping: consecutive flagged eligible slots; missing/ineligible/unflagged slot breaks a group
scoring_contract.latency: first in-fault flag timestamp minus fault onset (alert start reported separately)
scoring_contract.matching: chronological one-to-one; requires >=1 contributing flag in [fault start, fault end)
scoring_contract.rolling_history: earlier readings, including earlier partitions, may initialise history

selection_rule: Applied identically to each method on the TUNING partition only, using the Handoff 3 scoring contract. 1) Feasible = candidates with false alert events per 24 eligible sensor-hours <= 1.0. 2) Among feasible, maximise faults detected. 3) Ties: minimise mean detection latency (first in-fault flag minus onset) over detected faults. 4) Ties: minimise false alert events. 5) Ties: prefer the most conservative setting (widest fixed band; for rolling, larger k then larger floor). If no candidate is feasible: rank by false alerts per 24 h ascending, then apply steps 2-5.
